'''Nightscreegs''' were creatures native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vernet]]. Nightscreegs had a mournful call, were active at night, and hunted by the light of the planet's three [[Moon/Legends|moons]]. Nightscreegs took mates and they hunted together.<ref name="TD">{{JournalCite|15|The Draw}}</ref>
